specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Project: Heroes2dBattleGame, a 2D turn-based hex tactics game. Art direction: Heroes of Might and Magic III / its HD edition translated into finely hand-painted 2D game art. Crisp illustrative silhouettes, restrained textured brushwork, rich but controlled jewel colors, selective detail, subtle dark outlines. Absolutely no photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy mobile-game plastic, anime or chibi. Design for readability at actual battle scale. Asset type: wide 16:9 battlefield concept, 1920x1080 or higher. Fixed elevated oblique SIDE battlefield view, armies would face each other LEFT and RIGHT like Heroes III combat, not a top-down tabletop and not a deep perspective corridor. Playable ground occupies 75 percent of the canvas, a broad flat 15 by 11 hex-compatible rectangular arena; any depth compression is uniform, no vanishing-point distortion. The background scenic strip is confined to upper 20 percent. Quiet middle-value ground, sparse tactical obstacle clusters, clear routes around them. No drawn grid, no text, no UI, no units: this is the painted environment layer for a programmatic pointy-top hex overlay. Do not place decoration across the central maneuvering lanes. Environment: northern mountain pass of Nor’Il’Skald. Slate blue and ivory snow, compacted gray snow across a broad clearing, old blue-gray stone watchtower at upper left, distant sharp glacier ridges along top, wind-bent fir trees only at far edges. Three compact isolated rock/ice clusters distributed asymmetrically, no obstacle taller than a human in the playable ground. A patch of blue ice is a legible terrain hazard near middle-right. Clear left and right deployment margins. Cold daylight, small warm ochre banners by tower. Evocative classic fantasy landscape with careful miniature-scale terrain painting.

Use case: stylized-concept. Project: Heroes2dBattleGame, a 2D turn-based hex tactics game. Art direction: Heroes of Might and Magic III / its HD edition translated into finely hand-painted 2D game art. Crisp illustrative silhouettes, restrained textured brushwork, rich but controlled jewel colors, selective detail, subtle dark outlines. Absolutely no photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy mobile-game plastic, anime or chibi. Design for readability at actual battle scale. Transform the FIVE reference characters into one polished 2D BATTLE SPRITE CONCEPT SHEET, wide 16:9. References are CHARACTER IDENTITY / costume references only; replace photographic treatment with painted game sprites. Flat warm light gray background. Five separate full-body characters in one evenly spaced horizontal row, no touching, complete feet and weapons inside canvas. Consistent elevated three-quarter battle camera, ALL characters facing RIGHT, alert idle combat poses; strong readable silhouettes and moderately simplified face details. From left: 1 Bubsilda, adult brunette elf woman, silver circlet, navy blue long battle coat and silver armor, translucent icy sword, narrow upright silhouette. 2 Linda, adult brunette fairy woman with four delicate dragonfly wings, leafy crown, pink-white-sage dress, dragonfruit staff, hovering a short distance above small soft shadow; clearly an adult, slightly smaller figure. 3 Lambert, adult human man with shoulder-length black hair and rectangular glasses, dark green-black leather/steel armor, round shield on back, carrying a wooden recurve BOW to express documented ranged role, a sheathed sword and tool pouch. 4 Golovach Lena, masculine fire dragonborn, short black hair, humanlike East Asian facial structure as reference, two dark horns, charcoal scales, armored legs, glowing ember forearms and fists, broad sturdy stance, no wings. 5 Thorin, squat adult bald dwarf with short brown beard, thick dark fur-trimmed blue cloak, huge travel backpack with bedroll, tool belt and practical heavy work hammer; lowest widest silhouette. Maintain recognizability, do not feminize Lena or give Thorin long hair. Scale differences intentional. Small elegant Cyrillic names under each, exactly: «Бубсильда», «Линда», «Ламберт», «Головач Лена», «Торин». No other text or decorative frames. These should look usable as battle unit design references rather than movie character posters.

Create a 2D ENEMY UNIT concept sheet based on the referenced red fairy elite and thorn guardian. Flat warm light gray background, wide 16:9, four separate full-body units in one evenly spaced row facing LEFT, same slightly elevated three-quarter side battle camera. Four designs left-to-right: red fairy scout with copper-red hair, red batlike wings, light leather and hooked magical claws, agile narrow stance; red fairy elite warrior matching reference silhouette with crimson hair, dark steel armor, compact bat wings, elongated crimson crystal-tipped polearm and dark shield, heavier upright silhouette; animated thorn-bush guardian matching second reference, squat hunched wooden body with leafy shoulders, branching horns, amber eyes, root feet and thorned vine forearms, bulky silhouette; an ice guardian summoned by Bubsilda, tall faceless articulated pale-blue ice and silver armor with spear, clean angular silhouette with recognizable humanoid legs and arms. The last is an allied summon for the same creature roster, not a villain. Strong distinction between light flyer, armored flyer, plant controller and ice defender. Comfortable blank margins, no overlap or cropped limbs. Exact small labels: «Патрульная», «Воительница», «Страж-куст», «Ледяной страж». No cinematic vignette, ground scene, card frames, particle cloud or UI. Combat-ready idle poses. Large readable color masses, handpainted 2D HD sprite design.

Absolutely no photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy mobile-game plastic, anime or chibi. Design for readability at actual battle scale. Transform these three references into a polished wide 16:9 2D boss BATTLE UNIT concept sheet. Flat warm light gray background, no frames. Three separate full-body designs, ample blank gaps, consistent elevated three-quarter SIDE battle camera all facing LEFT. Left quarter: STROGANESSA, mature woman with short ash-brown bob, crimson gold-trimmed floor-length dress, enormous RED BUTTERFLY WINGS (not bat wings), controlled green life magic in one hand and magenta dragonfruit in the other. Center quarter: LORD NETAK elf phase, adult light-skinned man with short tousled light-brown hair, pointed ears, black high-collar long velvet coat, silver embroidery and clasps, narrow smug posture, restrained violet magic at fingers, no giant staff. Right HALF: NETAK dragon phase, full creature in lateral three-quarter view, crouched obsidian black armored quadruped dragon with two backward horns, four readable legs, folded purple-black wings, curling tail within panel, violet eyes and fine violet fissures. Dragon is roughly twice human unit height but designed for a two-adjacent-hex footprint with folded wings; do not make it a 20-hex cinematic monster. Preserve recognizable horn and face structure of dragon reference. All subjects complete head to toe and tail, not portraits. Small exact Cyrillic labels under subjects: «Строганесса», «Нетак · I», «Нетак · II». No other text. Distinguish the two Netak phases through shared black/silver/violet design cues. Painted 2D late-90s fantasy strategy craft with modern clean edges, no photoreal texture.
